intent: Horizontal site nav. Dropdowns are kit DropdownMenu. Not SideNav. Not AppNav.
useWhen: Top-of-page site navigation with links and dropdowns
A horizontal bar of destinations, some of which open a menu
doNotUseWhen: Path to the current page — use Breadcrumb
Actions from a button — use DropdownMenu

itemShape.label: string
itemShape.groups: DropdownMenuGroup[]? dropdown items — presence of groups means dropdown

items.note: A dropdown item is detected by groups. A link item has href and no groups.

requirements: Link items are a with aria-current=page when active
Dropdowns are kit DropdownMenu with triggerStyle=nav
Only one dropdown open at a time

doNot: Do not invent NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuTrigger, NavigationMenuContent, NavigationMenuLink, NavigationMenuViewport, or NavigationMenuIndicator
Do not use radix or @base-ui/react navigation-menu
Do not use native select or details for dropdowns — use kit DropdownMenu
Do not use SideNav or AppNav for horizontal site nav
snippet: <NavigationMenu items={[{ id: "home", label: "Home", href: "/", active: true }, { id: "docs", label: "Docs", groups: [{ items: [{ id: "intro", label: "Introduction", href: "/docs" }] }] }]} />
